thesis: Visa should classify as a Compounder: moat trajectory, reinvestment/FCF, management and financial survival clear the required thresholds while price/Base remains below 1.2. The stock is not an Expectation Gap because valuation is around the 69th percentile of its own five-year P/E history, and the main risk is paying a full multiple for a great business. Hard Veto should clear.

evidence.claim: Current price $368.29 versus locked Base $328.59 and Bull $467.20.
Q3 revenue +14%, payments volume +10%, processed transactions +10%, VAS +33%.
FY2025 owner-style FCF proxy was about $20.68B.

counterevidence: Current price is above locked Base value.
Five-year valuation percentile is not cheap.
Regulation and client incentives can pressure monetization.
falsifiers: If MT/RF fall below 76 or price/Base rises above 1.2 without higher intrinsic value, Compounder eligibility fails.
